message:
Fix `Entrez.Parser.DataHandler` URL security check continuity (related to #5109 and #5114) (#5148)

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Do not stop checking URLs after first success

Previously, one passed check from DataHandler.verify_security
would disabled checks for any consecutive requests to URLs,
independent of URL scheme and target host.

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Rename flag .secure to .bypass_url_security

.. to better communicate what is doing

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Fix DataHandler.verify_security docstring

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Improve DataHandler.verify_security error message

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Add host jats.nlm.nih.gov to trusted URL hosts

This URL is used by two existing tests:
https://jats.nlm.nih.gov/archiving/1.3/JATS-archivearticle1-3-mathml3.dtd

* Tests/test_Entrez_parser.py: Cover DataHandler.verify_security continuity

* CONTRIB.rst|NEWS.rst: Add myself as a contributor for Biopython 1.87

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Trust all *.nlm.nih.gov domains

.. to allow changes on subdomain level in the future

Co-authored-by: Peter Cock <p.j.a.cock@googlemail.com>

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Trust external references from NCBI files

General idea by Michiel de Hoon.

* Bio/Entrez/Parser.py: Improve DataHandler.verify_security docstring

Co-authored-by: Peter Cock <p.j.a.cock@googlemail.com>
